Overcoming issues and challenges including:
Issues
• Production at 30% of potential
• 30% to 40% post-harvest loss
• Lack of markets
• Not able to get fair market price
Key challenges
• Limited data to develop predictable credit score for farmers
• Infrastructure constraints – aggregation, quality management
and logistics
